interfaces: scripts.swarm_v2.kubernetes.spec.load_policy(path) validates a Pod policy against docs/swarm-v2/schemas/pod-policy.json
PodTemplate(policy).render(admitted_launch) returns the Pod and its canonical sha256 digest, or raises PodSpecRefused with a reason
label swarm.agentihooks.io/provider-account and Secret swarm-account-<account> key token, matching antoncore admission policy swarm-worker-provider-account
compatibility: No earlier execution Pod protocol exists: this renderer is the first Kubernetes execution object and was never merged before. The local herdr runtime is unchanged and keeps reading AH_CC_TOKEN_<slug> from the operator environment. The renderer's admitted launch record names the account provider_account; launch.json credential_ref is untouched.

kind_dry_run: rendered execution Pods passed server side strict validation

limitations: Ephemeral storage is a fixed allotment per resource profile, not per launch
The spec digest covers the whole rendered manifest
The template version is a label over one renderer; restoring an older version means rendering with that policy
Stale attempt ownership, create idempotence and durability belong to SV2-KUB-02
The task payload digest is unkeyed sha256
The schema file is read from the repository tree, not from the installed wheel
No worker reads the mounted provider token file yet; the file mount is the antoncore delivery contract
The Firecracker RuntimeClass is optional policy input; SV2-SEC-06 makes it mandatory

probe_rollback.evidence_class: render level: the wrong and reverted Pods differ only in their probes
